verses.original: וּכְהִתְפַּלֵּ֤ל עֶזְרָא֙ וּכְ֨הִתְוַדֹּת֔וֹ בֹּכֶה֙ וּמִתְנַפֵּ֔ל לִפְנֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים נִקְבְּצוּ֩ אֵלָ֨יו מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֜ל קָהָ֣ל רַב־ מְאֹ֗ד אֲנָשִׁ֤ים וְנָשִׁים֙ וִֽילָדִ֔ים כִּֽי־ בָכ֥וּ הָעָ֖ם הַרְבֵּה־ בֶֽכֶה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·hiṯ·pal·lêl ‘ez·rā ū·ḵə·hiṯ·wad·dō·ṯō bō·ḵeh ū·miṯ·nap·pêl lip̄·nê bêṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm niq·bə·ṣū ’ê·lāw mî·yiś·rā·’êl qā·hāl raḇ- mə·’ōḏ ’ă·nā·šîm wə·nā·šîm wî·lā·ḏîm kî- ḇā·ḵū hā·‘ām har·bêh- ḇe·ḵeh
verses.literal: While Ezra prayed and made this confession weeping and falling facedown before the house of God a very large assembly of Israelites men women and children gathered around him and the people wept bitterly . . . . . . as well

verses.original: וַיַּעַן֩ שְׁכַנְיָ֨ה בֶן־ יְחִיאֵ֜ל מִבְּנֵ֤י עוֹלָם וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְעֶזְרָ֔א אֲנַ֙חְנוּ֙ מָעַ֣לְנוּ בֵאלֹהֵ֔ינוּ וַנֹּ֛שֶׁב נָשִׁ֥ים נָכְרִיּ֖וֹת מֵעַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ וְעַתָּ֛ה יֵשׁ־ מִקְוֶ֥ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַל־ זֹֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an šə·ḵan·yāh ḇen- yə·ḥî·’êl mib·bə·nê ʿō·lå̄m way·yō·mer lə·‘ez·rā ’ă·naḥ·nū mā·‘al·nū ḇê·lō·hê·nū wan·nō·šeḇ nā·šîm nā·ḵə·rî·yō·wṯ mê·‘am·mê hā·’ā·reṣ wə·‘at·tāh yêš- miq·weh lə·yiś·rā·’êl ‘al- zōṯ
verses.literal: Then Shecaniah son of Jehiel an Elamite . . . said to Ezra We have been unfaithful to our God by marrying foreign women from the people of the land yet in spite of this there is hope for Israel

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה נִֽכְרָת־ בְּרִ֣ית לֵ֠אלֹהֵינוּ לְהוֹצִ֨יא כָל־ נָשִׁ֜ים וְהַנּוֹלָ֤ד מֵהֶם֙ בַּעֲצַ֣ת אֲדֹנָ֔י וְהַחֲרֵדִ֖ים בְּמִצְוַ֣ת אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וְכַתּוֹרָ֖ה יֵעָשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh niḵ·rāṯ- bə·rîṯ lê·lō·hê·nū lə·hō·w·ṣî ḵāl nā·šîm wə·han·nō·w·lāḏ mê·hem ba·‘ă·ṣaṯ ’ă·ḏō·nāy wə·ha·ḥă·rê·ḏîm bə·miṣ·waṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū wə·ḵat·tō·w·rāh yê·‘ā·śeh
verses.literal: So now let us make a covenant before our God to send away all the foreign wives and their children . . . according to the counsel of my lord and of those who tremble at the command of our God Let it be done according to the Law

verses.original: ק֛וּם כִּֽי־ עָלֶ֥יךָ הַדָּבָ֖ר וַאֲנַ֣חְנוּ עִמָּ֑ךְ חֲזַ֖ק וַעֲשֵֽׂה׃פ
verses.transliteration: qūm kî- ‘ā·le·ḵā had·dā·ḇār wa·’ă·naḥ·nū ‘im·māḵ ḥă·zaq wa·‘ă·śêh
verses.literal: Get up for this matter is your responsibility and we will support you Be strong and take action

verses.original: וַיָּ֣קָם עֶזְרָ֡א וַיַּשְׁבַּ֣ע אֶת־ שָׂרֵי֩ הַכֹּהֲנִ֨ים הַלְוִיִּ֜ם וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לַעֲשׂ֛וֹת כַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּ֖ה וַיִּשָּׁבֵֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām ‘ez·rā way·yaš·ba‘ ’eṯ- śā·rê hak·kō·hă·nîm hal·wî·yim wə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl la·‘ă·śō·wṯ kad·dā·ḇār haz·zeh way·yiš·šā·ḇê·‘ū
verses.literal: So Ezra got up and made the leading priests Levites and all Israel take an oath to do what had been said . . . . . . And they took the oath

verses.original: וַיָּ֣קָם עֶזְרָ֗א מִלִּפְנֵי֙ בֵּ֣ית הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיֵּ֕לֶךְ אֶל־ לִשְׁכַּ֖ת יְהוֹחָנָ֣ן בֶּן־ אֶלְיָשִׁ֑יב וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ שָׁ֗ם לֶ֤חֶם לֹֽא־ אָכַל֙ וּמַ֣יִם לֹֽא־ שָׁתָ֔ה כִּ֥י מִתְאַבֵּ֖ל עַל־ מַ֥עַל הַגּוֹלָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām ‘ez·rā mil·lip̄·nê bêṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yê·leḵ ’el- liš·kaṯ yə·hō·w·ḥā·nān ben- ’el·yā·šîḇ way·yê·leḵ šām le·ḥem lō- ’ā·ḵal ū·ma·yim lō- šā·ṯāh kî miṯ·’ab·bêl ‘al- ma·‘al hag·gō·w·lāh
verses.literal: Then Ezra withdrew from before the house of God and walked to the chamber of Jehohanan son of Eliashib And while he stayed there he ate no food and drank no water because he was mourning over the unfaithfulness of the exiles

verses.original: וַיַּעֲבִ֨ירוּ ק֜וֹל בִּיהוּדָ֣ה וִירֽוּשָׁלִַ֗ם לְכֹל֙ בְּנֵ֣י הַגּוֹלָ֔ה לְהִקָּבֵ֖ץ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·ḇî·rū qō·wl bî·hū·ḏāh wî·rū·šā·lim lə·ḵōl bə·nê hag·gō·w·lāh lə·hiq·qā·ḇêṣ yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: And a proclamation was issued throughout Judah and Jerusalem that all the exiles . . . should gather at Jerusalem

verses.original: וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־ יָב֜וֹא לִשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת הַיָּמִ֗ים כַּעֲצַ֤ת הַשָּׂרִים֙ וְהַזְּקֵנִ֔ים יָחֳרַ֖ם כָּל־ רְכוּשׁ֑וֹ וְה֥וּא יִבָּדֵ֖ל מִקְּהַ֥ל הַגּוֹלָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḇō·w liš·lō·šeṯ hay·yā·mîm ka·‘ă·ṣaṯ haś·śā·rîm wə·haz·zə·qê·nîm yā·ḥo·ram kāl- rə·ḵū·šōw wə·hū yib·bā·ḏêl miq·qə·hal hag·gō·w·lāh
verses.literal: Whoever failed to appear within three days would forfeit all his property . . . according to the counsel of the leaders and elders and would himself be expelled from the assembly of the exiles

verses.original: וַיִּקָּבְצ֣וּ כָל־ אַנְשֵֽׁי־ יְהוּדָה֩ וּבִנְיָמִ֨ן׀ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם לִשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת הַיָּמִ֗ים ה֛וּא חֹ֥דֶשׁ הַתְּשִׁיעִ֖י בְּעֶשְׂרִ֣ים בַּחֹ֑דֶשׁ וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ כָל־ הָעָ֗ם בִּרְחוֹב֙ בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים מַרְעִידִ֥ים עַל־ הַדָּבָ֖ר וּמֵהַגְּשָׁמִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qā·ḇə·ṣū ḵāl ’an·šê- yə·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇin·yā·min yə·rū·šā·lim liš·lō·šeṯ hay·yā·mîm hū ḥō·ḏeš hat·tə·šî·‘î bə·‘eś·rîm ba·ḥō·ḏeš way·yê·šə·ḇū ḵāl hā·‘ām bir·ḥō·wḇ bêṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm mar·‘î·ḏîm ‘al- had·dā·ḇār ū·mê·hag·gə·šā·mîm
verses.literal: So within the three days all the men of Judah and Benjamin assembled in Jerusalem . . . and on the twentieth day . . . of the ninth month all the people sat in the square at the house of God trembling regarding this matter and because of the heavy rain

verses.original: וַיָּ֨קָם עֶזְרָ֤א הַכֹּהֵן֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אַתֶּ֣ם מְעַלְתֶּ֔ם וַתֹּשִׁ֖יבוּ נָשִׁ֣ים נָכְרִיּ֑וֹת לְהוֹסִ֖יף עַל־ אַשְׁמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām ‘ez·rā hak·kō·hên way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem ’at·tem mə·‘al·tem wat·tō·šî·ḇū nā·šîm nā·ḵə·rî·yō·wṯ lə·hō·w·sîp̄ ‘al- ’aš·maṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then Ezra the priest stood up and said to them You have been unfaithful by marrying foreign women adding to the guilt of Israel

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה תְּנ֥וּ תוֹדָ֛ה לַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם וַעֲשׂ֣וּ רְצוֹנ֑וֹ וְהִבָּֽדְלוּ֙ מֵעַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ וּמִן־ הַנָּשִׁ֖ים הַנָּכְרִיּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh tə·nū ṯō·w·ḏāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê- ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem wa·‘ă·śū rə·ṣō·w·nōw wə·hib·bā·ḏə·lū mê·‘am·mê hā·’ā·reṣ ū·min- han·nā·šîm han·nā·ḵə·rî·yō·wṯ
verses.literal: Now, therefore make a confession to the LORD the God of your fathers and do His will Separate yourselves from the people of the land and from your foreign wives

verses.original: וַיַּֽעְנ֧וּ כָֽל־ הַקָּהָ֛ל וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ ק֣וֹל גָּד֑וֹל כֵּ֛ן כְּדִבְרֶיךָ עָלֵ֖ינוּ לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya‘·nū ḵāl haq·qā·hāl way·yō·mə·rū qō·wl gā·ḏō·wl kên kə·ḏiḇ·rɛ·ḵå̄ ‘ā·lê·nū la·‘ă·śō·wṯ
verses.literal: And the whole assembly . . . responded in a loud voice Truly we must do as you say . . .

verses.original: אֲבָ֞ל הָעָ֥ם רָב֙ וְהָעֵ֣ת גְּשָׁמִ֔ים וְאֵ֥ין כֹּ֖חַ לַעֲמ֣וֹד בַּח֑וּץ וְהַמְּלָאכָ֗ה לֹֽא־ לְי֤וֹם אֶחָד֙ וְלֹ֣א לִשְׁנַ֔יִם כִּֽי־ הִרְבִּ֥ינוּ לִפְשֹׁ֖עַ בַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḇāl hā·‘ām rāḇ wə·hā·‘êṯ gə·šā·mîm wə·’ên kō·aḥ la·‘ă·mō·wḏ ba·ḥūṣ wə·ham·mə·lā·ḵāh lō- lə·yō·wm ’e·ḥāḏ wə·lō liš·na·yim kî- hir·bî·nū lip̄·šō·a‘ bad·dā·ḇār haz·zeh
verses.literal: But there are many people here and it is the rainy season We are not able to stay out in the open Nor is this the work of one or two days for we have transgressed greatly in this matter

verses.original: יַֽעֲמְדוּ־ נָ֣א שָׂ֠רֵינוּ לְֽכָל־ הַקָּהָ֞ל וְכֹ֣ל׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בֶּעָרֵ֗ינוּ הַהֹשִׁ֞יב נָשִׁ֤ים נָכְרִיּוֹת֙ יָבֹא֙ לְעִתִּ֣ים מְזֻמָּנִ֔ים וְעִמָּהֶ֛ם זִקְנֵי־ עִ֥יר וָעִ֖יר וְשֹׁפְטֶ֑יהָ עַ֠ד לְהָשִׁ֞יב חֲר֤וֹן אַף־ אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ עַ֖ד לַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ya·‘ăm·ḏū- nā śā·rê·nû lə·ḵāl haq·qā·hāl wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer be·‘ā·rê·nū ha·hō·šîḇ nā·šîm nā·ḵə·rî·yō·wṯ yā·ḇō lə·‘it·tîm mə·zum·mā·nîm wə·‘im·mā·hem ziq·nê- ‘îr wā·‘îr wə·šō·p̄ə·ṭe·hā ‘aḏ lə·hā·šîḇ ḥă·rō·wn ’ap̄- ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū mim·men·nū ‘aḏ lad·dā·ḇār haz·zeh
verses.literal: Let our leaders represent . . . the whole assembly Then let everyone in our towns who has married a foreign woman come at an appointed time together with the elders and judges . . . of each town . . . until the fierce anger . . . of our God in this matter is turned away from us

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ יוֹנָתָ֧ן בֶּן־ עֲשָׂהאֵ֛ל וְיַחְזְיָ֥ה בֶן־ תִּקְוָ֖ה עָמְד֣וּ עַל־ זֹ֑את וּמְשֻׁלָּ֛ם וְשַׁבְּתַ֥י הַלֵּוִ֖י עֲזָרֻֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ yō·w·nā·ṯān ben- ‘ă·śā·h·’êl wə·yaḥ·zə·yāh ḇen- tiq·wāh ‘ā·mə·ḏū ‘al- zōṯ ū·mə·šul·lām wə·šab·bə·ṯay hal·lê·wî ‘ă·zā·rum
verses.literal: Only Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah supported by Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite opposed . . . this plan

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ־ כֵן֮ בְּנֵ֣י הַגּוֹלָה֒ וַיִּבָּדְלוּ֩ עֶזְרָ֨א הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֲנָשִׁ֨ים רָאשֵׁ֧י הָאָב֛וֹת לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָ֖ם וְכֻלָּ֣ם בְּשֵׁמ֑וֹת וַיֵּשְׁב֗וּ בְּי֤וֹם אֶחָד֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִ֔י לְדַרְי֖וֹשׁ הַדָּבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū- ḵên bə·nê hag·gō·w·lāh way·yib·bā·ḏə·lū ‘ez·rā hak·kō·hên ’ă·nā·šîm rā·šê hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ lə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯām wə·ḵul·lām bə·šê·mō·wṯ way·yê·šə·ḇū bə·yō·wm ’e·ḥāḏ la·ḥō·ḏeš hā·‘ă·śî·rî lə·ḏar·yō·wōš had·dā·ḇār
verses.literal: So the exiles . . . did as proposed Ezra the priest selected men who were family heads each of them identified by name . . . to represent their families . . . On the first day of the tenth month they launched the investigation

verses.original: וַיְכַלּ֣וּ בַכֹּ֔ל אֲנָשִׁ֕ים הַהֹשִׁ֖יבוּ נָשִׁ֣ים נָכְרִיּ֑וֹת עַ֛ד י֥וֹם אֶחָ֖ד לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הָרִאשֽׁוֹן׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ḵal·lū ḇak·kōl ’ă·nā·šîm ha·hō·šî·ḇū nā·šîm nā·ḵə·rî·yō·wṯ ‘aḏ yō·wm ’e·ḥāḏ la·ḥō·ḏeš hā·ri·šō·wn
verses.literal: and by the first day of the first month they had dealt with all the men who had married foreign women

verses.original: וַיִּמָּצֵא֙ מִבְּנֵ֣י הַכֹּהֲנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֹשִׁ֖יבוּ נָשִׁ֣ים נָכְרִיּ֑וֹת מִבְּנֵ֨י יֵשׁ֤וּעַ בֶּן־ יֽוֹצָדָק֙ וְאֶחָ֔יו מַֽעֲשֵׂיָה֙ וֶֽאֱלִיעֶ֔זֶר וְיָרִ֖יב וּגְדַלְיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yim·mā·ṣê mib·bə·nê hak·kō·hă·nîm ’ă·šer hō·šî·ḇū nā·šîm nā·ḵə·rî·yō·wṯ mib·bə·nê yê·šū·a‘ ben- yō·w·ṣā·ḏāq wə·’e·ḥāw ma·‘ă·śê·yāh we·’ĕ·lî·‘e·zer wə·yā·rîḇ ū·ḡə·ḏal·yāh
verses.literal: Among the descendants of the priests who had married foreign women were found these descendants of Jeshua son of Jozadak and his brothers Maaseiah Eliezer Jarib and Gedaliah

verses.original: וַיִּתְּנ֥וּ יָדָ֖ם לְהוֹצִ֣יא נְשֵׁיהֶ֑ם וַאֲשֵׁמִ֥ים אֵֽיל־ צֹ֖אן עַל־ אַשְׁמָתָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tə·nū yā·ḏām lə·hō·w·ṣî nə·šê·hem wa·’ă·šê·mîm ’êl- ṣōn ‘al- ’aš·mā·ṯām
verses.literal: They pledged . . . to send their wives away and for their guilt they presented a ram from the flock as a guilt offering

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י אִמֵּ֔ר חֲנָ֖נִי וּזְבַדְיָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·mib·bə·nê ’im·mêr ḥă·nā·nî ū·zə·ḇaḏ·yāh
verses.literal: From the descendants of Immer Hanani and Zebadiah

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֖י חָרִ֑ם מַעֲשֵׂיָ֤ה וְאֵֽלִיָּה֙ וּֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֔ה וִיחִיאֵ֖ל וְעֻזִיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mib·bə·nê ḥā·rim ma·‘ă·śê·yāh wə·’ê·lî·yāh ū·šə·ma‘·yāh wî·ḥî·’êl wə·‘u·zî·yāh
verses.literal: From the descendants of Harim Maaseiah Elijah Shemaiah Jehiel and Uzziah

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֖י פַּשְׁח֑וּר אֶלְיוֹעֵינַ֤י מַֽעֲשֵׂיָה֙ יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל נְתַנְאֵ֔ל יוֹזָבָ֖ד וְאֶלְעָשָֽׂה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·mib·bə·nê paš·ḥūr ’el·yō·w·‘ê·nay ma·‘ă·śê·yāh yiš·mā·‘êl nə·ṯan·’êl yō·w·zā·ḇāḏ wə·’el·‘ā·śāh
verses.literal: From the descendants of Pashhur Elioenai Maaseiah Ishmael Nethanel Jozabad and Elasah

verses.original: וּמִֽן־ הַלְוִיִּ֑ם יוֹזָבָ֣ד וְשִׁמְעִ֗י וְקֵֽלָיָה֙ ה֣וּא קְלִיטָ֔א פְּתַֽחְיָ֥ה יְהוּדָ֖ה וֶאֱלִיעֶֽזֶר׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·min- hal·wî·yim yō·w·zā·ḇāḏ wə·šim·‘î wə·qê·lā·yāh hū qə·lî·ṭā pə·ṯaḥ·yāh yə·hū·ḏāh we·’ĕ·lî·‘e·zer
verses.literal: Among the Levites Jozabad Shimei Kelaiah (that is Kelita Pethahiah Judah and Eliezer

verses.original: וּמִן־ הַמְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים אֶלְיָשִׁ֑יב וּמִן־ הַשֹּׁ֣עֲרִ֔ים שַׁלֻּ֥ם וָטֶ֖לֶם וְאוּרִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·min- ham·šō·rə·rîm ’el·yā·šîḇ ū·min- haš·šō·‘ă·rîm šal·lum wā·ṭe·lem wə·’ū·rî
verses.literal: From the singers Eliashib From the gatekeepers Shallum Telem and Uri

verses.original: וּמִֽיִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִבְּנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֡שׁ רַ֠מְיָה וְיִזִּיָּ֤ה וּמַלְכִּיָּה֙ וּמִיָּמִ֣ן וְאֶלְעָזָ֔ר וּמַלְכִּיָּ֖ה וּבְנָיָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·mî·yiś·rā·’êl mib·bə·nê p̄ar·‘ōš ram·yāh wə·yiz·zî·yāh ū·mal·kî·yāh ū·mî·yā·min wə·’el·‘ā·zār ū·mal·kî·yāh ū·ḇə·nā·yāh
verses.literal: And among the other Israelites, from the descendants of Parosh Ramiah Izziah Malchijah Mijamin Eleazar Malchijah and Benaiah

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֖י עֵילָ֑ם מַתַּנְיָ֤ה זְכַרְיָה֙ וִיחִיאֵ֣ל וְעַבְדִּ֔י וִירֵמ֖וֹת וְאֵלִיָּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·mib·bə·nê ‘ê·lām mat·tan·yāh zə·ḵar·yāh wî·ḥî·’êl wə·‘aḇ·dî wî·rê·mō·wṯ wə·’ê·lî·yāh
verses.literal: From the descendants of Elam Mattaniah Zechariah Jehiel Abdi Jeremoth and Elijah

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֖י זַתּ֑וּא אֶלְיוֹעֵנַ֤י אֶלְיָשִׁיב֙ מַתַּנְיָ֣ה וִֽירֵמ֔וֹת וְזָבָ֖ד וַעֲזִיזָֽא׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·mib·bə·nê zat·tū ’el·yō·w·‘ê·nay ’el·yā·šîḇ mat·tan·yāh wî·rê·mō·wṯ wə·zā·ḇāḏ wa·‘ă·zî·zā
verses.literal: From the descendants of Zattu Elioenai Eliashib Mattaniah Jeremoth Zabad and Aziza

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֖י בֵּבָ֑י יְהוֹחָנָ֥ן חֲנַנְיָ֖ה זַבַּ֥י עַתְלָֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·mib·bə·nê bê·ḇāy yə·hō·w·ḥā·nān ḥă·nan·yāh zab·bay ‘aṯ·lāy
verses.literal: From the descendants of Bebai Jehohanan Hananiah Zabbai and Athlai

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֖י בָּנִ֑י מְשֻׁלָּ֤ם מַלּוּךְ֙ וַעֲדָיָ֔ה יָשׁ֖וּב וּשְׁאָ֥ל יְרֵמוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·mib·bə·nê bā·nî mə·šul·lām mal·lūḵ wa·‘ă·ḏā·yāh yā·šūḇ ū·šə·’āl yə·rē·mōṯ
verses.literal: From the descendants of Bani Meshullam Malluch Adaiah Jashub Sheal and Jeremoth

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵ֛י פַּחַ֥ת מוֹאָ֖ב עַדְנָ֣א וּכְלָ֑ל בְּנָיָ֤ה מַעֲשֵׂיָה֙ מַתַּנְיָ֣ה בְצַלְאֵ֔ל וּבִנּ֖וּי וּמְנַשֶּֽׁה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·mib·bə·nê pa·ḥaṯ mō·w·’āḇ ‘aḏ·nā ū·ḵə·lāl bə·nā·yāh ma·‘ă·śê·yāh mat·tan·yāh ḇə·ṣal·’êl ū·ḇin·nui ū·mə·naš·šeh
verses.literal: From the descendants of Pahath-moab Adna Chelal Benaiah Maaseiah Mattaniah Bezalel Binnui and Manasseh

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י חָרִ֑ם אֱלִיעֶ֧זֶר יִשִּׁיָּ֛ה מַלְכִּיָּ֖ה שְׁמַֽעְיָ֥ה שִׁמְעֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê ḥā·rim ’ĕ·lî·‘e·zer yiš·šî·yāh mal·kî·yāh šə·ma‘·yāh šim·‘ō·wn
verses.literal: From the descendants of Harim Eliezer Isshijah Malchijah Shemaiah Shimeon

verses.original: בְּנְיָמִ֥ן מַלּ֖וּךְ שְׁמַרְיָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nə·yå̄·min mal·lūḵ šə·mar·yāh
verses.literal: Benjamin Malluch and Shemariah

verses.original: מִבְּנֵ֖י חָשֻׁ֑ם מַתְּנַ֤י מַתַּתָּה֙ זָבָ֣ד אֱלִיפֶ֔לֶט יְרֵמַ֥י מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה שִׁמְעִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: mib·bə·nê ḥā·šum mat·tə·nay mat·tat·tāh zā·ḇāḏ ’ĕ·lî·p̄e·leṭ yə·rê·may mə·naš·šeh šim·‘î
verses.literal: From the descendants of Hashum Mattenai Mattattah Zabad Eliphelet Jeremai Manasseh and Shimei

verses.original: מִבְּנֵ֣י בָנִ֔י מַעֲדַ֥י עַמְרָ֖ם וְאוּאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: mib·bə·nê ḇā·nî ma·‘ă·ḏay ‘am·rām wə·’ū·’êl
verses.literal: From the descendants of Bani Maadai Amram Uel

verses.original: בְּנָיָ֥ה בֵדְיָ֖ה כְּלָהַי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nā·yāh ḇê·ḏə·yāh kə·lå̄·hay
verses.literal: Benaiah Bedeiah Cheluhi

verses.original: וַנְיָ֥ה מְרֵמ֖וֹת אֶלְיָשִֽׁיב׃
verses.transliteration: wan·yāh mə·rê·mō·wṯ ’el·yā·šîḇ
verses.literal: Vaniah Meremoth Eliashib

verses.original: מַתַּנְיָ֥ה מַתְּנַ֖י וְיַעֲשׂוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mat·tan·yāh mat·tə·nay wə·ya·ʿă·śō
verses.literal: Mattaniah Mattenai and Jaasu

verses.original: וּבָנִ֥י וּבִנּ֖וּי שִׁמְעִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·nî ū·ḇin·nui šim·‘î
verses.literal: From the descendants of Binnui Shimei

verses.original: וְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֥ה וְנָתָ֖ן וַעֲדָיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·še·lem·yāh wə·nā·ṯān wa·‘ă·ḏā·yāh
verses.literal: Shelemiah Nathan Adaiah

verses.original: מַכְנַדְבַ֥י שָׁשַׁ֖י שָׁרָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: maḵ·naḏ·ḇay šā·šay šā·rāy
verses.literal: Machnadebai Shashai Sharai

verses.original: עֲזַרְאֵ֥ל וְשֶׁלֶמְיָ֖הוּ שְׁמַרְיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·zar·’êl wə·še·lem·yā·hū šə·mar·yāh
verses.literal: Azarel Shelemiah Shemariah

verses.original: שַׁלּ֥וּם אֲמַרְיָ֖ה יוֹסֵֽף׃ס
verses.transliteration: šal·lūm ’ă·mar·yāh yō·w·sêp̄
verses.literal: Shallum Amariah and Joseph

verses.original: מִבְּנֵ֖י נְב֑וֹ יְעִיאֵ֤ל מַתִּתְיָה֙ זָבָ֣ד זְבִינָ֔א יַדּוֹ וְיוֹאֵ֖ל בְּנָיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mib·bə·nê nə·ḇōw yə·‘î·’êl mat·tiṯ·yāh zā·ḇāḏ zə·ḇî·nā yad·dō wə·yō·w·’êl bə·nā·yāh
verses.literal: And from the descendants of Nebo Jeiel Mattithiah Zabad Zebina Jaddai Joel and Benaiah

verses.original: כָּל־ אֵ֕לֶּה נָשְׂא֖י נָשִׁ֣ים נָכְרִיּ֑וֹת וְיֵ֣שׁ מֵהֶ֣ם נָשִׁ֔ים וַיָּשִׂ֖ימוּ בָּנִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’êl·leh nå̄·śə nā·šîm nā·ḵə·rî·yō·wṯ wə·yêš mê·hem nā·šîm way·yā·śî·mū bā·nîm
verses.literal: All these men had married foreign . . . women and some of them had children by these wives
